pages.title: Shake on It
pages.text: Try trading through the familiar trade window.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Choose an affordable villager offer and receive the goods. A committed purchase is required; browsing offers or offering food does not count.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Redesigned villages retain ordinary professions. Cycle a never-traded villager's offers with the native button; after trading native restrictions apply. Button position is configurable without replacing the trading screen.
